 Jets at Blackhawks projected lineups
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 November 13, 2026 
 Link copied 
 JETS (9-8-3) at BLACKHAWKS (5-13-1) 
 3:30 p.m. ET, CHSN, SN 
 Jets projected lineup 
 Kyle Connor -- Mark Scheifele -- Gabriel Vilardi
 Cole Perfetti -- Brayden Yager -- Dawson Mercer
 Alex Iafallo -- Adam Lowry -- Viggo Bjorck
 Cole Koepke -- Morgan Barron -- Nino Niederreiter
 Josh Morrissey – Mario Ferraro
 Dylan Samberg -- Neal Pionk
 Haydn Fleury -- Tyrel Bauer
 Nico Daws
 Stuart Skinner
 Scratched: Clay Stevenson 
 Injured: Nick Bjugstad (undisclosed), Dylan DeMelo (lower body), Isak Rosen (undisclosed) 
 Blackhawks projected lineup 
 Roman Kantserov -- Connor Bedard -- Tyler Bertuzzi
 Andrew Mangiapane -- Anton Frondell -- Patrick Kane
 Oliver Moore -- Frank Nazar -- Ryan Donato
 Cole Smith -- Ryan Greene -- Jordan Greenway
 Alex Vlasic -- Ian Cole
 Kevin Korchinski -- Artyom Levshunov
 Wyat Kaiser -- Sam Rinzel
 Spencer Knight
 Drew Commesso
 Scratched: Dillon Boucher, Ethan Del Mastro, Teuvo Teravainen 
 Injured: Bowen Byram (upper body) 
 Status report 
 Each team practiced in Chicago on Friday; the Blackhawks’ practice was optional … DeMelo is week to week; the defenseman was injured during an 8-3 win at the Dallas Stars on Thursday … Niederreiter will enter the lineup for Rosen, a forward who got "banged up" Thursday, according to Jets coach Scott Arniel. ... Byram skated Friday in a non-contact jersey; the defenseman is expected to miss his 13th straight game.
